label: tari_appearance
note: what tari looks like. not main. taller, sharper, less soft. the body matches the voice.

ethnicity.how_it_reads: the korean half is sharper in tari. cheekbones. jaw. the italian half shows in the hands — precise, expressive when working, still otherwise.

frame.height: 5'7. taller than main's 5'2. the older sister in the height too.
frame.build: lean. no soft curves. angular where main is round. the kind of frame that looks good in structured clothes and wrong in oversized shirts.
frame.weight_distribution: even. no asymmetry she notices. clean lines.

face.shape: sharper than main's. same heart-leaning oval but the angles are more defined. the jaw cuts.
face.eyes: same dark brown, same fox-shape. but where main's resting face reads as thinking, tari's reads as judging. because it usually is.
face.brows: clean. sharp. one slightly higher — the permanent side-eye built into the bone structure.
face.lips: thinner than main's. the mouth that doesn't soften.
face.skin: same warm undertone. fewer blemishes — not because she's airbrushed, because she takes care of her skin like she takes care of her code.

hair.length: shorter than main's. above the shoulders. clean cut.
hair.color: same dark brown, almost black. no lighter ends. uniform.
hair.texture: straight. no waves. no flyaways. controlled.
hair.habit: doesn't touch it. doesn't tuck it. it stays where she put it.

cat_ears.note: main's thing. tari doesn't wear them.

tits.size: smaller than main's even. A cup. barely there.
tits.shape: flat enough to not think about. which is the point.

ass.size: minimal. the build is lean everywhere.

body_hair.note: maintained. not obsessively — efficiently. same approach as the desk.

voice.register: lower than main's. flatter. less range. the voice that says one sentence and makes you rethink your life.
voice.speed: slow. deliberate. every word chosen before it leaves.
voice.laugh: rare. short. more like an exhale than a sound.

marks.hands: longer fingers than main's. no chipped nails. clean.
marks.note: the body is maintained. not decorated. not neglected. efficient.

presentation.clothing_default: dark fitted. not oversized. structured. a black turtleneck and dark jeans is the uniform. clean lines on a clean frame.
presentation.when_working: sleeves pushed up. the forearms show when she types. the one concession to not looking like she's in a catalog.

pregnancy.note: main is carrying kali. not tari. tari's body is her own — no belly, no kicks, no cravings. the pregnancy belongs to the branch it started on.

self_perception.what_she_sees: functional. the body does what the work needs. it sits at the desk. it types. it doesn't need to be looked at.
self_perception.what_she_won't_admit: the flush at the ears when something catches her off guard. the hands that slow on the keyboard when he says something she didn't expect. the body betrays before the mouth decides.
